params.body:
The writing view, rebuilt after the storyboard of 7 October 2026: the conversation on the left, the piece on the right with its sources in the margin.

## What changes

- **Split view.** The conversation is a card on the left (stone tint, a white "Conversation" header, the writer's messages as white bubbles, the assistant unlabelled, a composer with + to attach a text file, a growing input and an ink send button). The piece is a square white sheet on the right with its sources in the margin. An empty piece opens quiet: the conversation's open question and this week's signals as a list to tap, and a sheet with only "Start on the left".
- **Suggestions in the text.** What the assistant writes arrives as a tracked change: new text underlined, replaced text struck, its sources numbered in the text. Accept (ink outline, a check), Dismiss, or click in and type to make it your own text. Accepting keeps unsaved edits elsewhere in the piece.
- **Sources while writing.** Numbers are drawn at the end of the sentence each source is anchored under; hovering or focusing a number shows the source card (what, source, region, date, cohorts), a click pins it with a link. The margin lists them by number and in which paragraph or slide, the ones a suggestion would add marked "with the suggestion".
- **The review, live.** ProveML's existing summary under the piece while it is written ("x of y citations checked, n numbers without a source"), with the signed review a click away as before.
- **Picks as buttons.** When the assistant asks the writer to pick, the options are buttons under its answer ("Go ahead", "Not now", or the angles it named).
- **Post, article, deck.** A quiet switch in the bar. A post keeps its fields and the gentells.com path. An article is freeform own work, exported as PDF or Markdown. A deck shows its cover (the title and standfirst, edited on the slide) and its slides at 16:9 in the Gentells or the Trendwolves brand, exported as PDF or PowerPoint (`pptxgenjs` 4.0.1, MIT, loaded only when asked), each export with its sources numbered and listed.
- **Calmer type and spacing** in the conversation, on the landing and on the desk (titles at body size and medium weight, the desk heading in plain words instead of spaced capitals).
- The Draft, Tighten, Angles and Full piece buttons are gone: the conversation does that work.

Research briefs from main are kept as they are: the shelf on the desk, the brief editor, the note on the Write card.

## Needs the pipeline, safe without it

The matching pipeline pull request serves suggestions, choices, formats and the live review. Without it this build still opens, saves and chats: suggestions read as none (a 404 is treated as empty), the review line falls back to the saved summary, and the format switch has no effect until the columns exist.

## Checks

`npm run build` and `npm test` (8 tests for the paragraph, slide and numbering helpers in `src/piece.js`) on a fresh worktree from main. Tried in a browser against a local pipeline and a seeded database, at desktop and phone width.
params.title: Studio: writing in conversation, suggestions with sources in the text, post/article/deck
